x: In the last event of the evening, the 1 mile, honours went to Hancock and Bell, of Surrey W.C., who took the first two places, with Denyer, of the Poly, third.
Woodcock, Bell, Christie-Murray, Wildbur and Wells are a few whose names come to mind, and Dunlop over their own course wil be all out to win.
Bill loped off in his usual relaxed style and soon caught and passed Walton's Doggett, but Bell of TVH opened up an extra 25 seconds on Bill to give his club a useful lead of 36 seconds.
